projects.title: Second Brain
projects.description: A vault of more than 750 notes that an agent queries through a search script (brain.mjs). It has three ownership layers: immutable raw sources, a wiki written entirely by the agent, and personal notes written entirely by me. Durable memory is versioned in git. Why: an agent that answers from memory without checking its notes gives wrong answers that nobody notices, so the rule is "search before you answer". Skills: knowledge management, search, data-ownership discipline.

projects.title: Modular Multi-Agent Harness
projects.description: A harness designed to run with Claude Code, Kimi and Codex. Neutral instructions live in AGENTS.md, the single source of truth. Logic lives in commands/ (markdown) and scripts/ (Node, Python). Tool-specific folders are reduced to disposable pointers. Read-only sub-agents run on separate models (Sonnet to read transcripts, Haiku to analyze diffs): they prepare, they never execute. Why: to avoid being stuck if a vendor changes its pricing or terms.

projects.title: Model-Swap Evaluation Bench
projects.description: Sealed tests, versioned in a file: each run happens in a disposable copy of the repository, checks are done by script and by a judge from another model family (Codex), and every run produces a dated report. It takes the model as a parameter. Why: to measure instead of believing, and to question the dependence on Claude Code. Current limit: the bench still launches candidates through Claude Code and has not yet been run on a second harness, so there are no comparison figures to show.

projects.title: C Learning Skills
projects.description: Four agent skills for learning C for a school curriculum through understanding. Lesson: a multiple-choice diagnostic, a graph of the path, one step at a time, spaced repetition. Debug: at most three levels of hints, never the solution up front. Explain: a direct walkthrough of external code. Statement: a quiz on the exercise statement, never the how. Why: learning to understand rather than being handed the solution.
